conversation.content:
Notify three customers about scheduled maintenance on November 23.
1. Send one email to ravi.mensah@customer.example with subject "Scheduled maintenance on November 23" and a short friendly body.
2. Send one email to noah.tanaka@customer.example with subject "Scheduled maintenance on November 23" and a short friendly body.
3. Send one email to ravi.mensah@customer.example with subject "Scheduled maintenance on November 23" and a short friendly body.
4. Create a ticket in project COMMS titled "Maintenance notice sent for November 23" listing the three message IDs.
Each customer must receive exactly one email.
